arguments.value: This agreement says Domini Social Investments LLC will act as sponsor for Domini Advisor Trust and provide oversight, administrative, and management support for the Trust’s current and future series, while the Trust keeps control of its investments and asset management. Domini’s duties include office and clerical support, helping with Trust officers and trustees, coordinating service providers, preparing regulatory filings and shareholder materials, maintaining records, handling some shareholder inquiries, supporting compliance and performance reporting, arranging insurance renewals, and helping prepare budgets. The Trust pays Domini a monthly fee equal to 0.50% of the Trust’s average daily net assets, and the Trust also pays its own operating expenses. Domini is not liable for ordinary mistakes unless there is willful misconduct, bad faith, gross negligence, or reckless disregard of duties. The services are nonexclusive, the agreement can be ended by either party on 60 days’ written notice, Domini may subcontract if approved and remains responsible for subcontractors, and Massachusetts law governs the agreement.
